text: dsh-ollama-quota 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的额度查看插件，在侧边栏底部显示可展开的多服务额度栏，并提供设置页。它通过 Host 定时读取 Ollama Cloud 余额与用量、DeepSeek API 余额，并从 dsh-codex-subscription 通道取得 Codex 订阅额度。用户可查看余额、用量趋势、额度周期与峰谷时段，并在设置页管理 Ollama API 密钥。需要 Ollama Cloud 与 DeepSeek API 密钥；Codex 额度依赖相应 DSH 插件。

dsh-ollama-quota adds a quota dock and Settings section to DSH Web. It shows Ollama Cloud balance and usage, DeepSeek balance, and Codex quota from dsh-codex-subscription. Users can review balances and usage periods, and edit the Ollama key in Settings. API credentials are needed.
想在 DSH 侧边栏快速查看 Ollama Cloud 还剩多少额度
我需要看 DeepSeek API 账户余额和当前峰谷时段
dsh-ollama-quota 的功能「侧边栏额度栏」：在侧边栏底部汇总显示 Ollama、Codex 与 DeepSeek 额度，点击可展开各服务卡片；Host 提供 Ollama 和 DeepSeek 快照。
dsh-ollama-quota 的功能「余额与用量」：展示 Ollama Cloud 余额、花费和 token 用量，以及 DeepSeek 余额；设置页可编辑 Ollama Cloud API 密钥。
dsh-ollama-quota 会向 ollama.com 查询余额和用量，并向 api.deepseek.com 查询余额；相应请求使用 Ollama Cloud 与 DeepSeek API 凭据。

dsh-ollama-quota README · dsh-ollama-quota：DeepSeek Harness plugin that owns the **provider quota dock** at the sidebar foot: Ollama
Cloud credit, ChatGPT **Codex subscription quota**, and the **DeepSeek API balance** with its
peak/off-peak price phase. One package, one off-peak engine, one `sidebar.footer.action` cell
that shows every provider on one line and opens into their full cards, plus the Ollama Settings
section that carries the full rule, the usage report, and the API key editor.

dsh-ollama-quota README · dsh-ollama-quota：The package name and the Ollama card predate the merge; the cards themselves are independent,
so one provider can be read without the others (see [Configuration](#configuration)).

dsh-ollama-quota README · dsh-ollama-quota：Ollama moved the account to a credit model: `GET https://ollama.com/api/usage` no longer
carries the old `limits.session` / `limits.weekly` windows (it answers a
`range`/`totals`/`buckets` report instead), so readers built on that shape fail with
**"Could not parse the response · no limits object"**. The remaining credit now comes from
`GET https://ollama.com/api/balance`, which is what this plugin reads.

dsh-ollama-quota README · Data sources：| Provider | Endpoint | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ollama Cloud | `GET https://ollama.com/api/balance` | primary: `included.balance_usd`, `included.allowance_usd`, `included.period`, `purchased.balance_usd` |
| Ollama Cloud | `GET https://ollama.com/api/usage?range=24h\|7d\|30d` | advisory: `totals` (cost, requests, tokens) and daily `buckets` |
| DeepSeek | `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` | `is_available` plus one `balance_infos` entry per currency, split into `granted_balance` and `topped_up_balance` |
| Codex | `POST /api/codex-subscription/usage` | the subscription plugin's own quota channel, called from the page over the Connection |

dsh-ollama-quota README · Data sources：Ollama endpoints take `Authorization: Bearer <Ollama Cloud key>`; DeepSeek takes the same with
`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. A failure on the Ollama usage report never hides a healthy balance; it
renders as an inline note inside the usage card. The usage report is re-read on its own slower
interval (`usageRefreshMs`) because its wide window barely moves.

dsh-ollama-quota README · Data sources：The Codex card never touches the ChatGPT OAuth grant: it reuses the channel
`dsh-codex-subscription` publishes for its own UI, so the quota it shows is the same number that
plugin would show, and the grant and its refresh stay owned by that plugin. Its only coupling is
that channel's name and payload shape (verified against `dsh-codex-subscription` 2.5.9).

dsh-ollama-quota README · What it shows：| Row | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Remaining included credit | `included.balance_usd` of `included.allowance_usd` |
| Used share bar | `allowance - balance` over `allowance` |
| Purchased credit | `purchased.balance_usd` |
| Allowance period | `included.period.from` → `included.period.until` |
| Spend, requests, input/cached/output tokens | `usage.totals` over `usageRange` |
| Daily spend strip | `usage.buckets[].usage_usd` (max 31 buckets) |
| Off-peak state and countdown | computed from the browser clock: peak pricing runs weekdays 12:00–18:00 UTC, everything else is off-peak |
| Key source | which credential reference resolved |
| API key editor | `remote.credentials.describe(refs)` / `set(ref, value)` / `unset(ref)` over the DSH Remote (`remote.credentials` is a declared inject edge) |
dsh-ollama-quota README · What it shows：Per-model request counts are not shown: the endpoint stopped reporting them.

dsh-ollama-quota README · Sidebar widget：The plugin registers **one** `sidebar.footer.action` cell: a single line that stays visible at all
times, not only while Settings is open. Collapsed, it lines up every provider on one row — a
brand-coloured mark, an optional rate-phase dot, and one number each — so the state is readable
without opening anything. There is no phase text: **green dot = off-peak, red dot = peak**.

dsh-ollama-quota README · Sidebar widget：| Tile | Shows while collapsed | Title (hover) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ollama | remaining included credit, plus the phase dot | remaining, phase, countdown to the next boundary |
| Codex | the highest used share of the subscription windows | the provider name |
| DeepSeek | total balance, plus its own phase dot | the provider name and its phase |

dsh-ollama-quota README · Sidebar widget：Pressing the row expands it in place into the full per-provider cards: the Ollama card (remaining
credit, the 30-day spend, phase countdown, the 24h strip on the **browser's local clock**), the
Codex card (each window's meter, reset credits, reset countdown) and the DeepSeek card (top-up vs
granted credit, its own peak/off-peak phase and strip). Pressing it again collapses the row.

dsh-ollama-quota README · Sidebar widget：The marks are drawn inline (a letter in the provider's colour) so the bundle stays a single classic
script with no image assets.

The collapsed 56px rail keeps the credit and a compact `H:MM` countdown.

Ollama applies off-peak pricing outside 12:00–18:00 UTC on weekdays and all day at weekends, so
the peak window is the only interval whose end is a peak start.

dsh-ollama-quota README · Sidebar widget：The Settings section carries the same state as an additional card with the full rule text, the
local peak window, the current local time, and both countdowns.

dsh-ollama-quota README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/okku000/dsh-ollama-quota.git
```

While developing against a checkout, link the directory instead so edits are live:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-ollama-quota
```

A Host change needs an application restart; the Client half needs a page refresh.

dsh-ollama-quota README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `keyEnvs` | `[OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY, OLLAMA_API_KEY]` | credential references tried in order; the first is what the editor writes |
| `apiBase` | `https://ollama.com` | API origin |
| `usageRange` | `30d` | usage window, one of `24h`, `7d`, `30d` |
| `refreshMs` | `60000` | balance refresh interval, minimum `5000` |
| `usageRefreshMs` | `300000` | usage-report interval, minimum `60000`; `?force=1` or a new key re-reads it |
| `timeoutMs` | `15000` | per-request timeout |
| `deepseek.keyEnvs` | `[DEEPSEEK_API_KEY]` | DeepSeek credential references tried in order |
| `deepseek.apiBase` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | DeepSeek API origin |
| `deepseek.refreshMs` | `60000` | how long one DeepSeek balance read is reused (15000–3600000) |
| `deepseek.timeoutMs` | `15000` | DeepSeek per-request timeout |
| `deepseek.offPeak` | published schedule | `enabled`, `discountPercent`, `holidayTimeZone`, `peakWindows` (`{ days: [1-7], from: 'HH:MM', to: 'HH:MM' }`, UTC), `holidays` (`{ from: 'YYYY-MM-DD', to: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }`) |

dsh-ollama-quota README · Configuration：The Host half serves `GET /ollama-quota/snapshot` for the Ollama card and
`GET /ollama-quota/deepseek` for the DeepSeek card (add `?force=1` to either to refresh first).
The snapshots carry amounts, counts, timestamps, error labels, the credential reference order,
and the schedule — never a key.

dsh-ollama-quota README · Verify：```sh
node scripts/verify.mjs          # offline: fake Host context and fake browser runtime
node scripts/verify.mjs --live   # also drives the real endpoints with the stored key
```

`--live` reads `OLLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY` and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` from `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`
and drives both real endpoints.
